results.title: Only Me
results.overview: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

results.title: People & Things
results.overview: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

results.title: Booking
results.overview: Donna is a ride-hailing driver who sells her body to her passengers as extra service. But when she falls for her passenger Jane, will love stop Donna from doing the only way she knows how to pay her debts?

results.title: Human Animal Camp
results.overview: Human Animal Camp exposes a brutal network of human trafficking and forced labor along Vietnam’s western border, where victims trapped inside a ruthless scam compound join forces with undercover investigators to orchestrate a daring escape.

results.title: The Culprits
results.overview: After carrying the silence of a teenage abortion for years, filmmaker Marta Duran Lozano gathers the anonymous testimonies of women who have lived through similar experiences. Alongside teenage girls who have recently had abortions, she embarks on a collective creative process, revisiting, embodying, and reimagining these intimate stories.

results.title: What If Christmas
results.overview: Erin has always supported her husband Adam, a heart surgeon, by organizing the hospitals' Christmas charity galas. However, when he moves to a new hospital, her help is no longer needed. Feeling lost and without a purpose back in New York City, her long-suppressed regrets over giving up her dream of pursuing fashion design start bubbling up. When Erin is given a peculiar heart-shaped Christmas ornament, she wakes up in an alternate reality where she's a world-famous fashion designer. As she "meets" and attends Christmas events with alternate-universe Adam, she realizes that while her fashion dreams came true, it's lonely at the top. While working on a way to bring more charity and heart to her fashion empire, she learns that her dream life and love were always right in front of her – if only she finds the heart and courage to ask.

results.title: The Price of Peace
results.overview: After the war, the authorities seek punishment against Karl Skov, and his family is more divided than ever.

results.title: Algorithm Party
results.overview: Algorithm Party is an authentic, forthright glimpse into working class life, told with a blunt honesty with humour and compassion. Roy’s deft, articulate and startlingly observed musings veer from the comic to the calamitous in a breath, cutting to the quick of the broad swathe of people and personalities that comprise his native city of Liverpool - from struggling parents to small-time criminals, pent-up white-collar workers to drinkers long lost to the ale.

results.title: Aroopi
results.overview: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

results.title: Gudang Merica
results.overview: A medical student’s routine hospital rotations take a terrifying turn when an unidentified patient dies under their care, triggering supernatural encounters and the mysterious disappearance of the body that forces them to confront a disturbing hidden truth.

results.title: Everest
results.overview: As a promising beginning at Rehnbjerg Academy unravels, day student Daniel's encounter with the charismatic boarding student August unleashes forbidden emotions in a toxic culture, leading them to a perilous crossroads.

results.title: Apolonia
results.overview: Justyna, a young archaeologist conducting research on the graves of "cursed soldiers" - victims of crimes committed by the communist security apparatus - discovered in Pułtusk, must confront her own family's past.

results.title: Miasma
results.overview: Doctor Antrobus takes time out from running an asylum to fight an unspeakble monster, which kills with its own flatulence.

results.title: Words of Love
results.overview: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

results.title: O'Romeo
results.overview: What fate awaits a stonehearted gangster and bloodthirsty womaniser when true love claims him, helpless and unguarded? A gang war that shakes the entire underworld and crime syndicate to their very roots. A forbidden love; the tale of an unrequited passion.

results.title: Dao
results.overview: A family weaves the threads of a heritage that travels between worlds. Joy and pain, memory and transmission. A wedding in France, a commemorative ceremony in Guinea-Bissau. Two celebrations, organically intertwined through bodies and time, leading to a rebirth.

results.title: Hive
results.overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

results.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
results.original_title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
results.overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

results.title: An Epilogue
results.overview: During his nightshift at a hospice ward, the caregiver Per encounters an unexpected person from his past. As death draws near, they fumble their way towards a final conversation where words no longer suffice.
